commit_message: Align ADR 0117 tests with project-first lifecycle
pr_title: Implement ADR 0117 project-first Launcher and Editor lifecycle
pr_body: Follow-up after full validation: migrate Editor lifecycle tests away from removed in-process project open/create paths, retain only a cfg(test)-only subsystem initialization shim for narrow fixtures, exercise lifecycle-owned scaffold and persisted workspace restore through EditorApp::from_project, and fix EditorPreferences Clippy findings. Re-run full Windows validation.
